like.heading: What I Love
bboy_paragraphs: I started bboying in a college dance circle. I love dancing, but watching jams and events is just as fun. The breakdancing community has a warmth unlike anything else — newcomers are naturally welcomed into the circle. That's the vibe I keep coming back to.
